ring_hop_steps.note: chain slot 16. 009F4DA0's own body is a throttle ceiling on brain+34Ch / +350h built from 0070D140 / 0070D0F0 / 0082E850 / 0070E3C0 over BSP_UnitInstance_GetReferenceSpeed, and no packet has reconstructed it, so it stays a record. It gates nothing on this path: the routine's ONLY exit is the tail call at 009F50C6, taken whether or not brain+0B38h skipped the body at 009F4DAF.
CALL 009F3F80 with ECX = ESI+8 set at 009F50C0, which is brain+8h = blk. 15680 of 15680 controller steps reached it.

009F3FEB CMP byte [ESI+3F5h],0 / 009F3FF2 JNZ 009F4D00, the routine's one early out and the only branch that skips the hop. blk+3F5h is the byte 009ED6B0 returns on; nothing in this process writes it. 0 of 15680 steps were gated.

009F3FF8..009F402E, two independent loads of [unit+97Ch] each shifted left by 5: 009F400D reads the slot's +83Ch (rudder) and 009F4025 its +838h (throttle). This is the ring slot under the WRITE cursor, not the 84-byte AI order slot 009F4D10 publishes.

the hull's signed forward speed, read once at the head. Its value reaches only the two byte flags at 009F4043 and 009F4077 that the unprojected arms consume, so the call site runs and the value goes nowhere in this projection.

009F4072..009F407B, CALL EDX = [[blk+3FCh]]+50h: the unit's own heading getter. This process answers it with atan2(row2.x, row2.z), the same value the trajectory dump's heading column carries, and records the dispatch.

009F4081 CMP [ESI+35Ch],2 then 00438AA0(heading, [00D7A264]): a ship latched astern is steered about the reciprocal of its own heading. 00D7A264 is the 3.14159265f bsp/unit_state_message.hpp already names. Not reached in either validation run: every unit of this mission latches Stopped or Ahead.
00438B10(blk+324h, heading): the heading error, the one value the rudder law is driven with.

one record for the two spans this packet does not project: 009F40CA..009F44E3, the ten writers of blk+1D0h that docs/SHIP_AI_THROTTLE_TO_RING.md tabulates, and 009F4502..009F4B98, the two 2Ch-stride obstacle tables at blk+81Ch / blk+848h with the second rudder store at 009F46A0. Both can rewrite blk+1D0h and blk+1D4h before the hop reads them, so what reaches the ring here is the hop applied to the state's own desired pair.

FLD [EAX+524h] with EAX = [blk+3FCh]+538h, the divisor 009DA280 uses. 00831840 does not write class+524h, so the field has no recovered Lua key and MaxRotAngle (class+4F8h) stands in, exactly as src/ship_motion_probe.cpp does. the law's one call site, ECX = [unit+1018h] set at 009DA2D1. Not reached, for the same reason as the row above.

009F4B99..009F4D04 through bsp::ship_ai_order_ring_hop_009f4b99, the reconstruction packet cc_ai_throttle_ring made operation for operation. Every path through 009F3F80 converges here: the three callee-saved pops at 009F4BBF..009F4BC5 are unconditional and the only RET is at 009F4D04. 15680 hops.

[unit + ([unit+97Ch]<<5) + 83Ch]. Always the first of the two setters. 15680 writes.

already run by this executable since milestone 2i, inside 00825F20 and once per unit per fixed step, so no new wiring was needed: the tick steps the live pair at ring+148h / +14Ch toward the read slot and, in session mode 1, sets the read cursor to the old write cursor. ai_drive_steps.note: NOT a call site of the executable's recovered path: a labelled diagnostic stand-in. --ai-drive names a unit, and on each re-plan tick whose state step is one of the eight records the executable calls bsp::ship_ai_set_desired_throttle_009dbf90 on that unit's control block with the switch's throttle in place of the state step's decision. It carries no `address` because no native site calls it here; the state's own vtable +0Ch at 009F5186 is what would.

the same, for the rudder. Note its own side effect, which is recovered and not substituted: 009DFFB0 sets blk+1C4h to Rudder, which is exactly what closes the 009F44E4 gate on the rudder law for the driven unit.

probe_comparison.steady_state: from t = 7.00 s the two orders are equal to the printed precision and the difference stops growing: throttle delta 0, rudder delta 0, speed delta 0.0002 m/s, yaw rate delta 0.00000 rad/s and a constant heading offset of 0.4004 deg. The position separation then grows from 3.68 m to 4.51 m only because two arcs of the same radius offset by 0.4 deg of phase diverge as they turn.
probe_comparison.explanation: the whole difference is the transient. The hop slews the ring slot by at most dt * 1.5 (00CE3D78), so the driven ship's order takes 0.333 s to reach rudder 0.5 and 0.667 s to reach throttle 1.0 after the switch engages at in-mission frame 5. The probe's --throttle/--rudder path issues the full pair into the ring through 00816A40 every step, so the only slew on its side is the ring's own 8.0 / 2.0 per second at 00813020 over a slot four positions ahead of the read cursor. Same class, same profile, different route into the ring.

corrections.was: docs/SHIP_AI_THROTTLE_TO_RING.md's chain table, step 5: `009F3F80 rewrites blk+1D0h / +1D4h, then the hop`, with no gate named
corrections.is: 009F3F80 has an early out before any of that. 009F3FEB CMP byte [ESI+3F5h],0 / 009F3FF2 JNZ 009F4D00 jumps straight to the epilogue, so a set blk+3F5h skips the ring read, the whole body and the hop. It is the same byte 009ED6B0 returns on. Nothing writes it in this process, so the gate was open on all 15680 steps, but the doc's chain omits it.
corrections.evidence: 009f3ff2 JNZ 009f4d00; 009f4d00 POP ESI / ADD ESP,24h / RET 4

corrections.was: the same doc's rudder section: `009DA250 is the only writer of blk+1D4h inside 009F3F80: both stores, 009F44FC and 009F46A0, take its result`
corrections.is: true, and incomplete in a way that decides this milestone. Neither store is unconditional. 009F44E4 CMP [ESI+1C4h],0 / JZ 009F4502 skips the first whenever the steering mode is Rudder, and the second sits inside the obstacle-table arm. Every state this mission reaches leaves blk+1C4h at Rudder, so the executable called 009DA250 zero times in 15680 steps and the rudder that reached the ring is the one the state asked for, not one the law built.
corrections.evidence: 009f44e4, 009f44eb; the run's rudder_law=0; every sampled row reads mode=rudder

corrections.is: the tool cannot read the probe's current stdout. Its `_PROBE_ROW` regex expects the step number followed by eight numeric columns; bsp_ship_motion_probe.exe now prints nine, because a `y` column was added to the table when the Dyn integrator landed. corrections.was: tools/verify_report_calls.py's live function lookup: `if 'No function' not in text and 'error' not in text.lower()`
corrections.is: the bare-substring test rejects any function whose NAME contains `error`. The bridge answered `Function: BSP_ShipAi_RudderFromHeadingError at 009da250 | ... | Body: 009da250 - 009da3a4` for 009DA250 and the script reported `callee 009da250 is not a Ghidra function` and `call site 009da2d7 is in no Ghidra function`. The test now matches only a reply that BEGINS with `error`, which is the shape this client's own exception path writes. Re-running it on reports/game_executable_milestone_2n.json still reports 49 rows checked and 0 failed, so the change loosens nothing that packet relied on.
corrections.evidence: tools/verify_report_calls.py:88 before the change; the bridge reply quoted above; 2n's report re-verified at 49 / 0

the reconstruction in src/unit_state_message.cpp, for the cursor rule that decides how many frames late the hop's write reaches the motion: in session mode 1 the read cursor jumps to the old write cursor, so a write on step N is the motion's input on step N+1.
